question: What is the scientific name of the land on which crops are grown?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Arable land.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Arable land is the scientific name of the land on which crops are grown.**
 
• **Arable lands:**
 
 
• These lands of India are becoming saline because of Over-irrigation.
 
• In the areas having intensive cultivation and excessive use of irrigation, the soil is losing its fertility and becoming saline.
 
• Dry climates having excessive irrigation create capillary action by which deposition of salt occurs on the top layer of the soil making it saline.
 
• Because of over-irrigation, a large part of arable land is irrigated zones of the country are becoming saline.
